title: Hunger Vital Sign™ (Food Insecurity Screen)
about: Two statements about the household's food in the past 12 months, from Children's HealthWatch. It has no total: often or sometimes true to either is a positive screen, at risk for food insecurity.

source.name: The Hunger Vital Sign™, Children's HealthWatch

blocks.label: For each statement, check whether it was often true, sometimes true, or never true for your household.

blocks.text: Often true or Sometimes true to either question 1 or 2: positive screen, at risk for food insecurity (Hager 2010).
Never true to both questions 1 and 2: negative screen.
Counts on UDS Table 6A line 39 (screening for upstream drivers of health) when it is added to OpenEMR's questionnaires from the Clinic Forms page and answered there.
